analyst_view.overall: Second-placed Feyenoord host Excelsior (15th), who have lost five league games in a row, including 0-9 at home to Twente. Feyenoord are winless in four in all competitions, including a 5-3 defeat at Heerenveen (their first league loss) and Champions League defeats, so Giovanni van Bronckhorst needs a response. Their defence is thin: St. Juste (counted by the numbers), Nieuwkoop, Bos, Beelen and Wessels are out and Gijs Smal and Anis Hadj Moussa are 50/50, but attackers Reiss Nelson, Goncalo Borges and Shaqueel van Persie are back. Excelsior's Nesto Groen serves the last game of his ban (counted) and Aymen Sliti is a doubt with a hand injury. The numbers add a big derby boost for cards, but this Rotterdam derby is a lopsided, friendly one (Feyenoord have won 47 of 57 meetings, and Feyenoord welcomed the Excelsior fans warmly), so I trim that.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.9 goals, already counting Excelsior's collapse (22 conceded in six), St. Juste's absence and Groen's ban. Feyenoord get Nelson, Borges and Van Persie back in attack, while a back line missing four or five regulars keeps the door open for Excelsior too; a mild +4% to about 4.1.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.1 corners, with Feyenoord taking most of them (6.8) and Excelsior's drop in corners already in the momentum adjustment. Hadj Moussa, Feyenoord's direct winger, is only 50/50, but Nelson and Borges give other wide options, so I stay at 10.1.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.6 cards, and that already includes a +39% derby boost plus referee Robin Hensgens' average record. This city derby is not a hostile one: Feyenoord have dominated it for decades and the clubs' fans get on, and a one-sided game with Feyenoord on the ball usually brings few fouls from the home side. I trim it -6% to about 3.4.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.3 shots, with Feyenoord on 19.2 and Excelsior on just 9.1 after a dismal run (45 shots in six games, already counted). Feyenoord's returning attackers support a high home total, but that is already the numbers' expectation, so I stay at 28.3.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.9 shots on target, already including Excelsior giving up many on-target shots (+9% for Feyenoord) and barely hitting the target themselves. With Sliti doubtful and Groen banned, Excelsior's threat stays small, and the numbers already see that, so I stay at 10.9.
